answer: I would anchor trust in C2PA manifest on the answer draft. With a signed manifest proving the draft's origin, a single dawn check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because a signed manifest proving the draft's origin is bound to a single identity — the reef is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the garden of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
